hints.title: Two-Stack Cursor Model
hints.text: Maintain two character collections: one for characters to the left of the cursor, and one for characters to the right.

hints.title: Cursor Movements as Transfers
hints.text: Moving left pops characters from the left collection and pushes them to the right. Moving right does the reverse.

hints.title: Left Prefix Retrieval
hints.text: After cursor movement, return the last min(10, len(left)) characters from the left collection.

hints.title: Two-Stack Text Editor Implementation

complexity.time: O(len(text)) for add, O(k) for delete/move
variables: k: number of characters moved or deleted
complexity.notes: Each character transfer between left and right stacks takes O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single string insertion and deletion with index slicing takes O(n) per operation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two stacks collectively store all document characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements two stacks or gap buffer to achieve amortized constant character operations.
